criteria.question: does unilateral labellar sugar input (LB3b, LB3c) favour the contralateral MN9, as Shiu et al. 2024 predicted?
criteria.source: Shiu et al. 2024 Nature 634:210-219 (prediction); Tastekin et al. 2026 Cell 189:5527-5551 (LB3b, LB3c sugar)
criteria.sides: explicit only (somaSide, else _L/_R instance suffix); cells without one are excluded

measure.kind: input-normalised signed path products from each side's afferents onto the left and the right MN9 cells separately (the model's edge signs)

L1_sugar_contralateral_bias.rule: point record: for the left and for the right sugar afferents separately, cumulative signed influence on the contralateral and on the ipsilateral MN9 are both above 0 and contralateral >= 1.10 x ipsilateral; PASS only if both sides do

criteria.reported: the same unsigned; bitter (LB1a-d); the old mixed proxy; the hop at which each side's bias first appears

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
